title: Hypercontractive random variable
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty probability space with the uniform distribution, let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$, let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The random variable $X$ is hypercontractive with parameters $(p,q,\rho)$ if, for every $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^q$ norm of $a+\rho bX$ is at most the uniform $L^p$ norm of $a+bX$.
